content: {"praised":["Tarzan’s strength and swimming ability are highlighted.","Viewers enjoyed the movies despite initial expectations.","Family members appreciate the series and enjoy it.","Fans express enthusiasm for the Tarzan character.","Cheeta’s longevity is noted as a positive point."],"criticized":["Tarzan is portrayed too civilized and cannot yell.","The set is filled with non‑original Tarzan films.","Only one Gordon Scott film, contrary to expectations.","Films have white patches and streaks, poor condition.","The series lacks the authentic Tarzan feel."]}
